extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Agents evaluator configuration page in an “Edit evaluator” form. A deterministic Exact Match evaluator is being configured with the name “Conclusion Evaluator,” a description explaining that it checks exact string matches, and the target output field set to “Conclusion.” The Name and Target output fields are visually highlighted.
extraction.step_instructions:
In the Name field, enter “Conclusion Evaluator”.
Select “Deterministic” from the Category dropdown.
Select “Exact Match” from the Type dropdown.
In the Description field, enter “An evaluator that checks for exact string matches between expected and actual outputs”.
In the Target output fields field, enter “Conclusion”.
